title: $4.8M CryoTrack Enterprise Cold-Chain Monitoring Agreement for Global Vaccine Distribution
executive_summary: PharmaCold Logistics proposes a $4.8M annual CryoTrack deployment to monitor 12,000 vaccine containers across 45 EMEA and APAC hubs with real-time excursion detection. Technical review reveals critical gaps between sales guarantees on availability, penalties, and coverage versus engineering constraints and maintenance limits.

proposal_document.title: Commercial Proposal v1.0
proposal_document.text: PharmaCold Logistics is pleased to offer CryoTrack Enterprise for $4.8M annually covering 12,000 refrigerated containers across 45 distribution hubs in EMEA and APAC. Our platform guarantees continuous real-time thermal logging every 30 seconds across all containers with 99.99% data availability and zero-gap audit trails for WHO GDP compliance, with instant excursion alerts within 60 seconds of any temperature exceeding 8°C for more than 10 minutes. This fixed price includes unlimited global cellular and satellite failover at no extra cost with 24/7 proactive monitoring by our Cold-Chain NOC, and guarantees 100% FDA 21 CFR Part 11 validated cloud retention for 10 years. We further commit to full deployment across all 45 hubs in 21 days with no scheduled downtime, plus automatic $25,000 penalty credit per temperature excursion event missed by our system.

technical_specification.title: Technical Architecture Spec v4.2
technical_specification.text: The CryoTrack sensor mesh (Model CT-400) is engineered to transmit thermal readings every 5 minutes via LTE-M as primary, with Iridium satellite as optional add-on module requiring separate subscription. System availability is rated at 99.5% excluding scheduled maintenance windows of 4 hours every Sunday 02:00-06:00 UTC during which telemetry ingestion is paused and buffered locally for up to 48 hours. All telemetry is stored in AWS Frankfurt with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 validated cloud retention for 10 years with immutable WORM storage and audit trails. Deployment follows a phased rollout of 90-120 days across regions subject to site readiness and customs clearance, with monitoring provided by the NOC during regional business hours (08:00-18:00 CET/SGT) and best-effort after-hours response, while satellite failover coverage is limited to pre-approved corridors and subject to additional fees.

commitments.claim: Continuous real-time logging with 99.99% availability and zero-gap audit trails with no downtime
commitments.proposal_quote: continuous real-time thermal logging every 30 seconds across all containers with 99.99% data availability and zero-gap audit trails for WHO GDP compliance
commitments.spec_quote: System availability is rated at 99.5% excluding scheduled maintenance windows of 4 hours every Sunday 02:00-06:00 UTC during which telemetry ingestion is paused
commitments.explanation: Proposal promises 99.99% availability with zero gaps and no downtime, while spec explicitly allows only 99.5% and pauses ingestion for 4 hours weekly, plus uses 5-minute intervals not 30-second continuous logging.

commitments.claim: Automatic $25,000 penalty credit per missed temperature excursion event
commitments.proposal_quote: automatic $25,000 penalty credit per temperature excursion event missed by our system
commitments.explanation: The technical specification contains no SLA penalty, credit mechanism, or financial liability for missed excursions, and does not define excursion detection liability at all.

commitments.claim: Unlimited global cellular and satellite failover with 24/7 proactive NOC monitoring
commitments.proposal_quote: unlimited global cellular and satellite failover at no extra cost with 24/7 proactive monitoring by our Cold-Chain NOC
commitments.spec_quote: monitoring provided by the NOC during regional business hours (08:00-18:00 CET/SGT) and best-effort after-hours response, while satellite failover coverage is limited to pre-approved corridors and subject to additional fees
commitments.explanation: Spec limits monitoring to business hours with best-effort after-hours and restricts satellite to pre-approved corridors with extra fees, leaving scope of unlimited global coverage and 24/7 obligation undefined and open to dispute.

commitments.claim: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 validated cloud retention for 10 years
commitments.proposal_quote: guarantees 100% FDA 21 CFR Part 11 validated cloud retention for 10 years
commitments.spec_quote: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 validated cloud retention for 10 years with immutable WORM storage and audit trails
commitments.explanation: Spec directly confirms 10-year FDA 21 CFR Part 11 validated retention with immutable WORM storage, fully supporting the sales claim.
